GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 3rd last rails 6 Lengths 800m, Saved Ground back inside and Made Some Ground but was never a factor # never close

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , little change to Turn then Hooked Out to 4 Lengths Four Wide , steered centre of track Straightening Up , hampered and carried wider 200m, made very little ground in Straight # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages. Hampered and carried wider passing the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced well back Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed well back Two Wide midrace & 3 Wide @ 600m. Improving slowly 3 Wide @ 500m & Four Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 250m & ran on soundly in last 150m. # Last 150m OK.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in, bumping a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out then hooked across and Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 7.5 Lengths rail turning, railed right up rounding turn and Made Some Ground along fence in Straight # never left fence
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From its wide barrier, was directed in behind runners shortly after the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked hard early to settle outside leader. 2nd turn. weakened # worked early
Jumped Ok Went Forward to lead 1 Lengths 800m .5 Lengths lead home turn 1st 1 Lengths kicked 250m Kept Going Too Well # led/slow pace/win
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn then steered across to 5 lanes off outside fence, Lost Ground in the run home # in average going

Buffeted coming out of the barriers & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , shuffled back to 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out 3 Wide at 350m then Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Warning placed on it for being difficult to load.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Difficult to load - warning issued. Bumped on jumping.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4.5 Lengths rail turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and made up a couple of lengths in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly approaching/rounding first turn.] # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Travelled keenly approaching and rounding the first turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn , off heels Straightening Up , hit Lead 140m kept going to post # pipped on post
Jumped okay & Went Forward to 0.75 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led same margin turning, Headed 100m, kept battling to post # led/battled fairly

Jumped okay & Settled Down Five Wide trailing a length and a quarter, pressed forward and took Lead wdie out at 950m, went clear and crossed at 850m, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, kept giving in Straight and only Headed 120m out. # worked early/fair
